title: Preparation of Luria–Bertani (LB) Agar Plates
key_sentences: This procedure describes the preparation, sterilisation and pouring of LB agar plates for routine bacterial culture.
It applies to all staff and students who prepare media in the Media Preparation Unit.
Store the plates inverted at 2–8 °C and use them within four weeks.
Record the batch number, date and preparer in the media log.
Discard any plate that shows contamination, cracking or drying.

list_items.text: Wear a laboratory coat, safety glasses and heat-resistant gloves when handling hot media.
Never open the autoclave until the chamber pressure has returned to zero.
Report any burn or spillage to the unit supervisor immediately.
Weigh the dry components into a 2 L glass bottle.
Add 900 mL of purified water and stir until the powders are fully suspended.
121 °C for 15 minutes on the liquid cycle;
loosen the cap by a quarter turn before loading.
Cool the medium to about 50 °C in a water bath.
If required, add the antibiotic aseptically and swirl gently to mix.
Pour approximately 20 mL into each sterile Petri dish and allow the plates to set.
